title: M1 - the same request, five times
doc_ref: docs.typesafe.ai/concepts/how-to-build-with-system-one - 'designed to return stable answers across repeated evaluations'
note: Ten states covering all three question types, each request repeated five times. Every threshold in a production system assumes the answer does not wander between calls; a value that moves by 0.1 across repeats makes a 0.8 cutoff meaningless. The states deliberately include the ambiguous ones, since that is where a distribution is flattest and instability would surface first.

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer appear?

states.state: My running shoes arrived in the wrong size. Can I swap them for a size 10?
The tracking page has said 'label created' for nine days now. Where is my package?
I was charged $120 twice for the same order. Please reverse the duplicate charge.
Shoes arrived two weeks late and in the wrong size. Also I see two charges of $120 on my card. What are you going to do about this?
I paid for two pairs but only one arrived, and my card shows the full amount.
The courier left the box out in the rain and everything inside is soaked. I want my money back for the whole order.
This is the second time I have had to ask about this one.
Quick question - does the Pro plan include SSO?
Three weeks, four emails, and nothing. I am cancelling both accounts and moving to a competitor.
